struct RecordError <: Exception
    msg::String
end

function encode_record(scope::String, name::String, arr::Array)::Vector{UInt8}
    scope_bytes = Vector{UInt8}(scope)
    name_bytes = Vector{UInt8}(name)
    shape = size(arr)
    dtype_bytes = Vector{UInt8}(string(eltype(arr)))
    arr_contig = Array(arr)
    if ENDIAN_BOM == 0x01020304
        arr_contig = bswap.(arr_contig)
    end
    arr_buffer = reinterpret(UInt8, vec(arr_contig))
    header = IOBuffer()
    write(header, Int32(length(scope_bytes)))
    write(header, Int32(length(name_bytes)))
    write(header, Int32(length(dtype_bytes)))
    write(header, Int32(length(shape)))
    write(header, Int32(length(arr_buffer)))
    header_bytes = take!(header)
    shape_buffer = IOBuffer()
    for s in shape
        write(shape_buffer, Int32(s))
    end
    shape_bytes = take!(shape_buffer)
    return vcat(header_bytes, scope_bytes, name_bytes, dtype_bytes, shape_bytes, arr_buffer)
end

function _read_record(stream::IO)::Union{Tuple{String, String, Array}, Nothing}
    header_size = 20
    header = read(stream, header_size)
    if isempty(header)
        return nothing
    end
    if length(header) < header_size
        throw(RecordError("Incomplete header: length(header)=$(length(header)) < header_size=$header_size"))
    end
    header_io = IOBuffer(header)
    scope_len = read(header_io, Int32)
    name_len = read(header_io, Int32)
    dtype_len = read(header_io, Int32)
    shape_len = read(header_io, Int32)
    arr_buffer_len = read(header_io, Int32)
    payload_size = scope_len + name_len + dtype_len + shape_len * 4 + arr_buffer_len
    payload = read(stream, payload_size)
    if length(payload) < payload_size
        throw(RecordError("Incomplete payload: length(payload)=$(length(payload)) < payload_size=$payload_size"))
    end
    payload_io = IOBuffer(payload)
    scope = String(read(payload_io, scope_len))
    name = String(read(payload_io, name_len))
    dtype_str = String(read(payload_io, dtype_len))
    shape = Int[]
    for _ in 1:shape_len
        push!(shape, read(payload_io, Int32))
    end
    dtype_type = dtype_str == "float32" ? Float32 : dtype_str == "float64" ? Float64 : dtype_str == "int32" ? Int32 : dtype_str == "int64" ? Int64 : Float32
    arr_bytes = read(payload_io, arr_buffer_len)
    arr = reinterpret(dtype_type, arr_bytes)
    arr = reshape(arr, Tuple(shape))
    if ENDIAN_BOM == 0x01020304
        arr = bswap.(arr)
    end
    return (scope, name, arr)
end

function read_records(stream::IO)
    records = []
    while true
        record = _read_record(stream)
        if record === nothing
            break
        end
        push!(records, record)
    end
    return records
end

mutable struct _MultiFileIO
    files::Vector{String}
    handles::Vector{IO}
    sizes::Vector{Int}
    length::Int
    offsets::Vector{Int}
    abspos::Int
    relpos::Tuple{Int, Int}
end

function _MultiFileIO(files::Vector{String})
    handles = [open(file, "r") for file in files]
    sizes = Int[]
    for handle in handles
        seekend(handle)
        push!(sizes, position(handle))
    end
    len = sum(sizes)
    offsets = [0]
    for s in sizes[1:end-1]
        push!(offsets, offsets[end] + s)
    end
    abspos = 0
    relpos = (1, 0)
    return _MultiFileIO(files, handles, sizes, len, offsets, abspos, relpos)
end

function _abs_to_rel(mfio::_MultiFileIO, pos::Int)::Tuple{Int, Int}
    idx = searchsortedlast(mfio.offsets, pos)
    return (idx, pos - mfio.offsets[idx])
end

function Base.close(mfio::_MultiFileIO)
    for handle in mfio.handles
        close(handle)
    end
end

function Base.read(mfio::_MultiFileIO, n::Int)::Vector{UInt8}
    result = UInt8[]
    remaining = n
    while remaining > 0
        idx, offset = mfio.relpos
        seek(mfio.handles[idx], offset)
        to_read = min(remaining, mfio.sizes[idx] - offset)
        data = read(mfio.handles[idx], to_read)
        append!(result, data)
        mfio.abspos += length(data)
        mfio.relpos = _abs_to_rel(mfio, mfio.abspos)
        remaining -= length(data)
        if mfio.abspos == mfio.length
            break
        end
    end
    return result
end

function Base.seek(mfio::_MultiFileIO, pos::Int)
    mfio.abspos = pos
    mfio.relpos = _abs_to_rel(mfio, pos)
end

function open_for_reading(model_files::Vector{String}, is_compressed::Bool)
    mfio = _MultiFileIO(model_files)
    if is_compressed
        error("Compression not implemented in Julia version")
    else
        return mfio
    end
end

function _match_model(paths::Vector{String}, pattern::Regex)::Dict{String, Vector{String}}
    models = Dict{String, Vector{String}}()
    for path in paths
        m = match(pattern, basename(path))
        if m !== nothing
            model_name = m[:model_name]
            if !haskey(models, model_name)
                models[model_name] = String[]
            end
            push!(models[model_name], path)
        end
    end
    for k in keys(models)
        models[k] = sort(models[k])
    end
    return models
end

function select_model_files(model_dir::String, model_name::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing)::Tuple{Vector{String}, Bool}
    files = [joinpath(model_dir, f) for f in readdir(model_dir) if isfile(joinpath(model_dir, f))]
    patterns = [
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.([0-9]+)\.bin\.zst$", true),
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.bin\.zst\.([0-9]+)$", true),
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.([0-9]+)\.bin$", false),
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.bin\.([0-9]+)$", false),
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.bin\.zst$", true),
        (r"(?P<model_name>.*)\.bin$", false)
    ]
    for (pattern, is_compressed) in patterns
        models = _match_model(files, pattern)
        if model_name !== nothing
            if haskey(models, model_name)
                return (models[model_name], is_compressed)
            end
        else
            if !isempty(models)
                if length(models) > 1
                    error("Multiple models matched in $model_dir")
                end
                model_files = first(values(models))
                return (model_files, is_compressed)
            end
        end
    end
    error("No models matched in $model_dir")
end

function get_model_haiku_params(model_dir::String)::Dict{String, Dict{String, Array}}
    params = Dict{String, Dict{String, Array}}()
    model_files, is_compressed = select_model_files(model_dir)
    stream = open_for_reading(model_files, is_compressed)
    for (scope, name, arr) in read_records(stream)
        if !haskey(params, scope)
            params[scope] = Dict{String, Array}()
        end
        params[scope][name] = arr
    end
    close(stream)
    if isempty(params)
        error("Model missing from \"$model_dir\"")
    end
    return params
end

function lazy_parse_fasta_string(fasta_string::String)
    lines = split(fasta_string, "\n")
    results = Tuple{String, String}[]
    current_desc = ""
    current_seq = ""
    for line in lines
        line = strip(line)
        if isempty(line)
            continue
        end
        if startswith(line, ">")
            if !isempty(current_seq)
                push!(results, (current_seq, current_desc))
            end
            current_desc = line[2:end]
            current_seq = ""
        else
            current_seq *= line
        end
    end
    if !isempty(current_seq)
        push!(results, (current_seq, current_desc))
    end
    return results
end

function parse_fasta(fasta_string::String)::Tuple{Vector{String}, Vector{String}}
    sequences = String[]
    descriptions = String[]
    for (seq, desc) in lazy_parse_fasta_string(fasta_string)
        push!(sequences, seq)
        push!(descriptions, desc)
    end
    return (sequences, descriptions)
end

function convert_a3m_to_stockholm(a3m::String, max_seqs::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing)::String
    sequences, descriptions = parse_fasta(a3m)
    if max_seqs !== nothing
        sequences = sequences[1:min(max_seqs, length(sequences))]
        descriptions = descriptions[1:min(max_seqs, length(descriptions))]
    end
    stockholm = ["# STOCKHOLM 1.0", ""]
    names = String[]
    for (i, description) in enumerate(descriptions)
        parts = split(replace(description, "\t" => " "), " ", limit=2)
        name = parts[1]
        rest = length(parts) > 1 ? parts[2] : ""
        name = "$(name)_$i"
        push!(names, name)
        desc = strip(rest)
        if isempty(desc)
            desc = ""
        end
        push!(stockholm, "#=GS $(strip(name)) DE $desc")
    end
    push!(stockholm, "")
    sequences = convert_a3m_to_stockholm_sequences(sequences)
    max_name_width = maximum(length(name) for name in names)
    for (name, sequence) in zip(names, sequences)
        push!(stockholm, rpad(name, max_name_width) * " " * sequence)
    end
    ref_annotation = join([c == '-' ? '.' : 'x' for c in sequences[1]], "")
    push!(stockholm, rpad("#=GC RF", max_name_width) * " " * ref_annotation)
    push!(stockholm, "//")
    return join(stockholm, "\n")
end

function convert_a3m_to_stockholm_sequences(sequences::Vector{String})
    return sequences
end

function convert_stockholm_to_a3m(stockholm::IO; max_sequences::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing, remove_first_row_gaps::Bool=true, linewidth::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing)::String
    if linewidth !== nothing && linewidth <= 0
        error("linewidth must be > 0 or Nothing")
    end
    descriptions = Dict{String, String}()
    sequences = Dict{String, String}()
    reached_max_sequences = false
    for line in eachline(stockholm)
        reached_max_sequences = max_sequences !== nothing && length(sequences) >= max_sequences
        line = strip(line)
        if isempty(line) || startswith(line, "#") || startswith(line, "//")
            continue
        end
        parts = split(line, limit=2)
        seqname = parts[1]
        aligned_seq = parts[2]
        if !haskey(sequences, seqname)
            if reached_max_sequences
                continue
            end
            sequences[seqname] = ""
        end
        sequences[seqname] *= aligned_seq
    end
    if isempty(sequences)
        return ""
    end
    seekstart(stockholm)
    for line in eachline(stockholm)
        line = strip(line)
        if length(line) >= 4 && line[1:4] == "#=GS"
            columns = split(line, limit=4)
            seqname = columns[2]
            feature = columns[3]
            value = length(columns) == 4 ? columns[4] : ""
            if feature != "DE"
                continue
            end
            if reached_max_sequences && !haskey(sequences, seqname)
                continue
            end
            descriptions[seqname] = value
            if length(descriptions) == length(sequences)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    a3m_sequences = Dict{String, String}()
    query_sequence = first(values(sequences))
    for (seqname, sto_sequence) in sequences
        if remove_first_row_gaps
            a3m_sequences[seqname] = replace(align_sequence_to_gapless_query(sto_sequence, query_sequence), "." => "")
        else
            a3m_sequences[seqname] = replace(sto_sequence, "." => "")
        end
    end
    fasta_chunks = String[]
    for (seqname, seq) in a3m_sequences
        push!(fasta_chunks, ">$seqname $(get(descriptions, seqname, ""))")
        if linewidth !== nothing
            for i in 1:linewidth:length(seq)
                push!(fasta_chunks, seq[i:min(i+linewidth-1, end)])
            end
        else
            push!(fasta_chunks, seq)
        end
    end

function noise_embeddings(sigma_scaled_noise_level::Array{Float32})::Array{Float32}
    transformed_noise_level = (1 / 4) .* log.(sigma_scaled_noise_level)
    weight = Float32.(_WEIGHT)
    bias = Float32.(_BIAS)
    embeddings = transformed_noise_level .* reshape(weight, 1, :) .+ reshape(bias, 1, :)
    return cos.(2 * π .* embeddings)
end

using Statistics

function _align_species(all_species::Vector, chains_species_to_rows::Vector, min_hits_per_species::Dict)
    species_blocks = []
    for species in all_species
        chain_row_indices = []
        for species_to_rows in chains_species_to_rows
            min_msa_size = min_hits_per_species[species]
            if !haskey(species_to_rows, species)
                row_indices = fill(-1, min_msa_size)
            else
                row_indices = species_to_rows[species][1:min(min_msa_size, length(species_to_rows[species]))]
            end
            push!(chain_row_indices, row_indices)
        end
        species_block = hcat(chain_row_indices...)
        push!(species_blocks, species_block)
    end
    aligned_matrix = vcat(species_blocks...)
    return aligned_matrix
end

function create_paired_features(chains::Vector, max_paired_sequences::Int, nonempty_chain_ids::Set, max_hits_per_species::Int)
    species_num_chains = Dict()
    chains_species_to_rows = []
    min_hits_per_species = Dict()
    for chain in chains
        species_ids = chain["msa_species_identifiers_all_seq"]
        if isempty(species_ids) || (length(species_ids) == 1 && isempty(species_ids[1])) || !(chain["chain_id"] in nonempty_chain_ids)
            push!(chains_species_to_rows, Dict())
            continue
        end
        row_indices = collect(0:length(species_ids)-1)
        sort_idxs = sortperm(species_ids)
        species_ids = species_ids[sort_idxs]
        row_indices = row_indices[sort_idxs]
        species = unique(species_ids)
        unique_row_indices = [findfirst(==(s), species_ids) for s in species]
        grouped_row_indices = [row_indices[unique_row_indices[i]:i < length(unique_row_indices) ? unique_row_indices[i+1]-1 : end] for i in 1:length(unique_row_indices)]
        species_to_rows = Dict(zip(species, grouped_row_indices))
        push!(chains_species_to_rows, species_to_rows)
        for s in species
            species_num_chains[s] = get(species_num_chains, s, 0) + 1
        end
        for (species_key, row_indices_val) in species_to_rows
            min_hits_per_species[species_key] = min(get(min_hits_per_species, species_key, max_hits_per_species), length(row_indices_val))
        end
    end
    num_chains_to_species = Dict()
    for (species, num_chains) in species_num_chains
        if isempty(species) || num_chains <= 1
            continue
        end
        if !haskey(num_chains_to_species, num_chains)
            num_chains_to_species[num_chains] = []
        end
        push!(num_chains_to_species[num_chains], species)
    end
    num_rows_seen = 0
    all_rows = [fill(0, 1, length(chains))]
    for num_chains in sort(collect(keys(num_chains_to_species)), rev=true)
        all_species = num_chains_to_species[num_chains]
        rows = _align_species(all_species, chains_species_to_rows, min_hits_per_species)
        rank_metric = abs.(prod(Float32.(rows), dims=2))
        sorted_rows = rows[sortperm(vec(rank_metric)), :]
        push!(all_rows, sorted_rows)
        num_rows_seen += size(rows, 1)
        if num_rows_seen >= max_paired_sequences
            break
        end
    end
    all_rows = vcat(all_rows...)
    all_rows = all_rows[1:min(max_paired_sequences, size(all_rows, 1)), :]
    paired_chains = []
    for (chain_idx, chain) in enumerate(chains)
        out_chain = Dict(k => v for (k, v) in chain if !occursin("all_seq", k))
        selected_row_indices = all_rows[:, chain_idx]
        for feat_name in ["msa", "deletion_matrix"]
            all_seq_name = "$(feat_name)_all_seq"
            feat_value = chain[all_seq_name]
            pad_value = feat_name == "msa" ? -1 : 0
            feat_value = vcat(feat_value, fill(pad_value, 1, size(feat_value, 2)))
            feat_value = feat_value[selected_row_indices .+ 1, :]
            out_chain[all_seq_name] = feat_value
        end
        out_chain["num_alignments_all_seq"] = size(out_chain["msa_all_seq"], 1)
        push!(paired_chains, out_chain)
    end
    return paired_chains
end

function deduplicate_unpaired_sequences(np_chains::Vector)
    for chain in np_chains
        sequence_set = Set()
        for s in eachrow(chain["msa_all_seq"])
            push!(sequence_set, hash(s))
        end
        keep_rows = Int[]
        for (row_num, seq) in enumerate(eachrow(chain["msa"]))
            if !(hash(seq) in sequence_set)
                push!(keep_rows, row_num)
            end
        end
        for feature_name in keys(chain)
            if occursin("msa", feature_name) || occursin("deletion_matrix", feature_name)
                if !occursin("all_seq", feature_name)
                    chain[feature_name] = chain[feature_name][keep_rows, :]
                end
            end
        end
        chain["num_alignments"] = size(chain["msa"], 1)
    end
    return np_chains
end

function choose_paired_unpaired_msa_crop_sizes(unpaired_msa::Array, paired_msa::Union{Array, Nothing}, total_msa_crop_size::Int, max_paired_sequences::Int)
    if paired_msa !== nothing
        paired_crop_size = min(size(paired_msa, 1), max_paired_sequences)
        cropped_all_seq_msa = paired_msa[1:min(max_paired_sequences, size(paired_msa, 1)), :]
        num_non_gapped_pairs = size(cropped_all_seq_msa, 1)
        unpaired_crop_size = min(size(unpaired_msa, 1), total_msa_crop_size - num_non_gapped_pairs)
    else
        unpaired_crop_size = min(size(unpaired_msa, 1), total_msa_crop_size)
        paired_crop_size = nothing
    end
    return (unpaired_crop_size, paired_crop_size)
end

function remove_all_gapped_rows_from_all_seqs(chains_list::Vector, asym_ids::Vector)
    merged_msa_all_seq = hcat([chain["msa_all_seq"] for chain in chains_list if chain["asym_id"][1] in asym_ids]...)
    non_gapped_keep_rows = any(merged_msa_all_seq .!= -1, dims=2)
    for chain in chains_list
        for feat_name in keys(chain)
            if occursin("all_seq", feat_name)
                feat_name_split = split(feat_name, "_all_seq")[1]
                if feat_name_split in ["msa", "deletion_matrix"]
                    chain[feat_name] = chain[feat_name][vec(non_gapped_keep_rows), :]
                end
            end
        end
        chain["num_alignments_all_seq"] = sum(non_gapped_keep_rows)
    end
    return chains_list
end

struct MsaError <: Exception
    msg::String
end

function _featurize(seq::String, chain_poly_type::String)
    if is_standard_polymer_type(chain_poly_type)
        featurized_seqs, _ = extract_msa_features([seq], chain_poly_type)
        return featurized_seqs[1]
    end
    return seq
end

function sequences_are_feature_equivalent(sequence1::String, sequence2::String, chain_poly_type::String)::Bool
    feat1 = _featurize(sequence1, chain_poly_type)
    feat2 = _featurize(sequence2, chain_poly_type)
    return feat1 == feat2
end

function is_standard_polymer_type(chain_poly_type::String)::Bool
    return chain_poly_type in ["protein", "dna", "rna"]
end

function extract_msa_features(msa_sequences::Vector{String}, chain_poly_type::String)
    return (zeros(Int, length(msa_sequences)), zeros(Int, length(msa_sequences)))
end

mutable struct Msa
    query_sequence::String
    chain_poly_type::String
    sequences::Vector{String}
    descriptions::Vector{String}
end

function Msa(query_sequence::String, chain_poly_type::String, sequences::Vector{String}, descriptions::Vector{String}; deduplicate::Bool=true)
    if length(sequences) != length(descriptions)
        error("The number of sequences and descriptions must match.")
    end
    if !deduplicate
        final_sequences = sequences
        final_descriptions = descriptions
    else
        final_sequences = String[]
        final_descriptions = String[]
        unique_sequences = Set{String}()
        for (seq, desc) in zip(sequences, descriptions)
            sequence_no_deletions = replace(seq, r"[a-z]" => "")
            if !(sequence_no_deletions in unique_sequences)
                push!(unique_sequences, sequence_no_deletions)
                push!(final_sequences, seq)
                push!(final_descriptions, desc)
            end
        end
    end
    if isempty(final_sequences)
        final_sequences = [query_sequence]
        final_descriptions = ["Original query"]
    end
    if !sequences_are_feature_equivalent(final_sequences[1], query_sequence, chain_poly_type)
        error("First MSA sequence $(final_sequences[1]) is not the query_sequence=$query_sequence")
    end
    return Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, final_sequences, final_descriptions)
end

function from_multiple_msas(msas::Vector{Msa}; deduplicate::Bool=true)::Msa
    if isempty(msas)
        error("At least one MSA must be provided.")
    end
    query_sequence = msas[1].query_sequence
    chain_poly_type = msas[1].chain_poly_type
    sequences = String[]
    descriptions = String[]
    for msa in msas
        if msa.query_sequence != query_sequence
            error("Query sequences must match: $([m.query_sequence for m in msas])")
        end
        if msa.chain_poly_type != chain_poly_type
            error("Chain poly types must match: $([m.chain_poly_type for m in msas])")
        end
        append!(sequences, msa.sequences)
        append!(descriptions, msa.descriptions)
    end
    return Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, sequences, descriptions, deduplicate=deduplicate)
end

function from_multiple_a3ms(a3ms::Vector{String}, chain_poly_type::String; deduplicate::Bool=true)::Msa
    if isempty(a3ms)
        error("At least one A3M must be provided.")
    end
    query_sequence = nothing
    all_sequences = String[]
    all_descriptions = String[]
    for a3m in a3ms
        sequences, descriptions = parse_fasta(a3m)
        if query_sequence === nothing
            query_sequence = sequences[1]
        end
        if sequences[1] != query_sequence
            error("Query sequences must match: sequences[1]=$(sequences[1]) != query_sequence=$query_sequence")
        end
        append!(all_sequences, sequences)
        append!(all_descriptions, descriptions)
    end
    return Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, all_sequences, all_descriptions, deduplicate=deduplicate)
end

function from_a3m(query_sequence::String, chain_poly_type::String, a3m::String; max_depth::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing, deduplicate::Bool=true)::Msa
    sequences, descriptions = parse_fasta(a3m)
    if max_depth !== nothing && 0 < max_depth < length(sequences)
        println("MSA cropped from depth of $(length(sequences)) to $max_depth for $query_sequence.")
        sequences = sequences[1:max_depth]
        descriptions = descriptions[1:max_depth]
    end
    return Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, sequences, descriptions, deduplicate=deduplicate)
end

function from_empty(query_sequence::String, chain_poly_type::String)::Msa
    return Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, String[], String[], deduplicate=false)
end

function depth(msa::Msa)::Int
    return length(msa.sequences)
end

function to_a3m(msa::Msa)::String
    a3m_lines = String[]
    for (desc, seq) in zip(msa.descriptions, msa.sequences)
        push!(a3m_lines, ">$desc")
        push!(a3m_lines, seq)
    end
    return join(a3m_lines, "\n") * "\n"
end

function featurize(msa::Msa)::Dict{String, Any}
    try
        msa_array, deletion_matrix = extract_msa_features(msa.sequences, msa.chain_poly_type)
    catch e
        throw(MsaError("Error extracting MSA or deletion features: $e"))
    end
    if size(msa_array) == (0, 0)
        throw(MsaError("Empty MSA feature for $msa"))
    end
    species_ids = extract_species_ids(msa.descriptions)
    return Dict(
        "msa_species_identifiers" => species_ids,
        "num_alignments" => depth(msa),
        "msa" => msa_array,
        "deletion_matrix" => deletion_matrix
    )
end

function extract_species_ids(descriptions::Vector{String})
    return fill("", length(descriptions))
end

function parse_fasta(fasta_string::String)
    sequences = String[]
    descriptions = String[]
    lines = split(fasta_string, "\n")
    current_desc = ""
    current_seq = ""
    for line in lines
        line = strip(line)
        if isempty(line)
            continue
        end
        if startswith(line, ">")
            if !isempty(current_seq)
                push!(sequences, current_seq)
                push!(descriptions, current_desc)
            end
            current_desc = line[2:end]
            current_seq = ""
        else
            current_seq *= line
        end
    end
    if !isempty(current_seq)
        push!(sequences, current_seq)
        push!(descriptions, current_desc)
    end
    return (sequences, descriptions)
end

function get_msa_tool(msa_tool_config::Dict)
    if msa_tool_config["type"] == "jackhmmer"
        return create_jackhmmer(
            msa_tool_config["binary_path"],
            msa_tool_config["database_path"],
            msa_tool_config["n_cpu"],
            msa_tool_config["n_iter"],
            msa_tool_config["e_value"],
            msa_tool_config["z_value"],
            msa_tool_config["max_sequences"]
        )
    elseif msa_tool_config["type"] == "nhmmer"
        return create_nhmmer(
            msa_tool_config["binary_path"],
            msa_tool_config["hmmalign_binary_path"],
            msa_tool_config["hmmbuild_binary_path"],
            msa_tool_config["database_path"],
            msa_tool_config["n_cpu"],
            msa_tool_config["e_value"],
            msa_tool_config["max_sequences"],
            msa_tool_config["alphabet"]
        )
    else
        error("Unknown MSA tool: $(msa_tool_config["type"])")
    end
end

function create_jackhmmer(binary_path::String, database_path::String, n_cpu::Int, n_iter::Int, e_value::Float64, z_value::Int, max_sequences::Int)
    return Dict("type" => "jackhmmer")
end

function create_nhmmer(binary_path::String, hmmalign_binary_path::String, hmmbuild_binary_path::String, database_path::String, n_cpu::Int, e_value::Float64, max_sequences::Int, alphabet::String)
    return Dict("type" => "nhmmer")
end

function get_msa(target_sequence::String, run_config::Dict, chain_poly_type::String; deduplicate::Bool=false)::Msa
    tool_result = query_tool(get_msa_tool(run_config["config"]), target_sequence)
    return from_a3m(
        target_sequence,
        chain_poly_type,
        tool_result["a3m"],
        max_depth=run_config["crop_size"],
        deduplicate=deduplicate
    )
end

function query_tool(tool::Dict, target_sequence::String)
    return Dict("a3m" => ">query\n$target_sequence\n")
end
